in_hebrew.name: רַחֲמִים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Rachamim' is derived from the Hebrew root 'racham' which means 'to be soft, to have compassion, to be merciful'. The name 'Rachamim' is often used to describe God as a compassionate and merciful deity.

in_greek.name: ελεος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Eleos' is derived from the Greek word 'eleos' which means 'mercy, compassion'. The name 'Eleos' is often used as a name for the Greek goddess of mercy and compassion.

in_latin.name: Misericordia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Misericordia' is derived from the Latin words 'misericor' (merciful) and 'cordis' (heart). The name 'Misericordia' means 'compassionate heart' or 'mercy'.
